scorecard.venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c HC Brook b Washington Sundar

batting.name: PD Salt
batting.dismissal: c H Klaasen b B Kumar

batting.name: SN Khan
batting.dismissal: c B Kumar b Washington Sundar

batting.name: Aman Hakim Khan
batting.dismissal: c Abhishek Sharma b Washington Sundar

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c Aman Hakim Khan b AR Patel

batting.name: RA Tripathi
batting.dismissal: c PD Salt b I Sharma

batting.name: H Klaasen
batting.dismissal: c Aman Hakim Khan b A Nortje

balls.text: full on fifth stump, Kuldeep goes for a reverse scoop to this 115 kph slower ball and he gets enough bat on it for it to barely beat the short third fielder on the ring running across unable to get a hand to it and it backspins away to the rope for four. The only boundary across the final three overs.
length ball angled into middle and leg at 132 kph, flicked to long-on for one.

length ball on seventh stump, misses a swat as the ball bounces to Klaasen who collects and rips and underhand flick into the stumps to deny an attempted by as Ripal's diving effort to get back on strike fails.
yorker on middle at 133 kph, jammed out back to Bhuvi for a dot.

yorker on middle at 134 kph, flicked out to deep midwicket for a long single. Major confusion on whether or not to come back for a second taking on Umran Malik's arm. Nortje stopped for one, then belatedly took off after seeing Ripal charge halfway down the wicket for the second. But then Ripal stops and turns back leaving Nortje to be toast for the relay over the stumps to Klaasen. Bails taken off with Nortje five yards out.
slower length ball just inside the guideline beats Ripal backing away from leg stump trying to heave over midwicket for a dot.
full on middle, jammed out into extra cover for one.
full on the stumps, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
full on the stumps, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
low full toss at knee height on middle at 134 kph, punched down the ground for one.

short on fourth stump, pulled to deep midwicket for one, fumble by the fielder opens the door for them to attempt a dicey second but Sundar recovers well enough to pick up on the second attempt and fire a bullet straight over the bails to Heinrich Klaassen with Rimal's diving effort for the second run to stay on strike coming up two feet short.
full on middle, heaved out to deep midwicket for one.
good length ball on off, flicked into midwicket for one.
bullseye! 132 kph yorker on middle and off stump, Axar plays over the top of this trying to flick through midwicket and the ball ricochets off the toe into the stumps.
full on the stumps, jammed out down the ground for one.
yorker speared in following Pandey backing away from leg splits his legs to the keeper.
back of a length on off stump, goes to pull and misses off the thigh trickling behind square for one.
short and wide, slapped off the toe into cover for one.
short and wide, slapped wide of long-off for two.
short and wide, slapped through cover, the sweeper Jansen puts in an awkward tumble trying to stop this but fails.
full on middle, charges and punches over the bowler splitting long-on and long-off to the rope.
short and wide, slapped behind point and picks the gap backspinning away to the rope.
full and wide, goes to heave a googly that spins out of reach for a dot. Delhi asks for a review wanting this to be a wide instead of a dot.  It's deemed legal. Review lost.
full on the stumps, goes to heave and drags this through midwicket for one.
good length ball on the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
short outside leg, pulls to deep backward square leg for two.
full length ball on seventh stump, goes to slog and bottom edges a heave to deep fine leg for two.
full on sixth stump, sweeps this through to deep square leg for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, charges and punches down the ground for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, defended to backward point for none.
full and wide, backs away and slices a drive high over cover, one bounce over the rope.
yorker on middle at 133 kph, jammed out to long-on for one.
133 kph length ball on the legs, miscues a flick off the pads into midwicket for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, punched to long-off for one.
length ball on fourth stump at 129 kph, shoveled on the up to long-off, fielded on a bounce for one.
back of a length on the stumps, goes back to punch through to long-on for one.
slower ball yorker lands full on off at 121 kph, jammed out to cover for none.
full in the slot on fifth stump at 149 kph, driven firmly but straight to mid-off for none.
thigh high full toss on the wide guideline at 152 kph, miscues a cue shot to cover for none.
slower ball back of a length on seventh stump at 142 kph, slices this behind point for one.
length ball on seventh stump at 152 kph, backs away and slaps this through extra cover to the rope.
151 kph yorker on off, jammed out to mid-off for one. Throw to the non-striker's stumps connects and they think about an overthrow on the ricochet before deciding against it.
full on sixth stump, punched to long-off for one.
full on seventh stump, driven to long-off for one.
short and wide, slapped wide of the cover sweeper for two.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to wide long-off for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, goes back to swat to wide long-on for one.
good length ball on the stumps, goes back to punch down the ground for one.
147 kph delivery short on the hips, goes back to flick to deep fine leg for one.
back of a length on fourth stump at 146 kph, defended to extra cover.
full on seventh stump at 145 kph, punched through cover to the sweeper for one.
147 kph ball lands short on sixth stump, goes to cut and scuffs this into short cover for none.
yorker on middle and leg at 148 kph, jammed out into midwicket for one.
147 kph delivery slinged full outside leg, flicked away with a simple flourish and it skids wide of deep fine leg to the rope.
short and wide on sixth stump, goes to cut and misses.
full and wide almost off the pitch, would've been a wide if left alone but Pandey reaches out one-handed and toe pokes this through cover for one.
another full ball lands outside leg, this time chipped wide of midwicket for one.
floated full outside leg, defended gently to midwicket.
short on fourth stump, goes back to pull this just wide of midwicket in the ring and a diving stop at wide long-on keeps this to two.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched to extra cover for none.
back of a length quicker ball at 97 kph on middle, punched off the back foot to long-off for one.
short on fourth stump, pulled to deep midwicket for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, prods forward at this and an inside edge squirts past leg stump for one to short fine leg.
back of a length on middle, defended to Sundar.
back of a length on middle, punched off the back foot to midwicket for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to extra cover for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched wide of the point sweeper for two.
flighted very slowly at 76 kph on a good length on seventh stump, left alone.
googly lands short on fifth stump, punched to long-off for one.
back of a length on middle, punched to long-on for one.
full on middle, chipped high over the non-striker to long-off for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, defended to extra cover.
googly spins sharply down leg, slides past Pandey and the keeper for two wides.

another ridiculous heave by Khan, and this time he doesn't get away with it. Flighted wider on sixth stump, Khan steps forward to try to smash this down the ground again after a lucky shave on his first ball but this time skies a top edge over cover in the ring. Basic catch taken at chest height on the edge of the circle.
flighted full on middle, awkward slog produces a top edge that swirls between long-on and long-off. It bounces short of Jansen but he overruns the ball badly and it slips past him to the rope.

full on leg stump, another batter falls to the sweep! Sarfaraz was not in control of this. Tries to smash this along the ground but it floats off more of a top edge and sails to the deep backward square leg fielder for the right-hander. It's Bhuvneshwar out there who comes in five yards for a much simpler chance taken upright at thigh height.
good length ball on middle, flicked tentatively through mid-on for one.

too full on the legs, Warner shuffles across for another slog sweep but manages to pick out Harry Brook at deep backward square leg. Warner has a wry smile walking off. He smashed this pretty cleanly but Brook judged this sharply scampering 10 yards to his right and five yards in off the rope before lunging forward for a knee height catch.
good length ball slanted into the legs, misses a back foot punch off the pads.
good length ball on middle, goes back to punch to long-off for one.
googly lands on a fullish length on sixth stump, Warner shuffles across and leaves it alone.
short and wide on eighth stump, Warner cranks a cross bat shot through extra cover and it beats the sweeper to the rope.
good length ball on middle, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
back of a length on middle, Warner goes back to pull to long-on for one.
good length on leg stump, premeditated a sweep that is swatted through backward square leg for one.
back of a length on off at 136 kph, guided to deep third for one.

fullish length swinging into the pads at 142 kph, Sarfaraz late on a flick as the ball comes off the pads to cover, stifled lbw shout denied. Markram takes much longer before calling for another DRS review. But this one looks pretty hopeless. Live it looked like it pitched outside leg and was missing leg too. Sure enough, ball-tracking confirms this was pitching comfortably outside leg stump. Review lost.
fullish length on sixth stump at 133 kph, punches this high over wide long-off, it carries thudding into the base of the LCD ad boards for six.
back of a length on fifth stump at 134 kph, goes to punch but the ball skids low under the shot before bouncing again before the keeper.
back of a length on the legs, flicked to square leg for one.
136 kph delivery lands full on middle and leg, flicked high to deep midwicket for one.
back of a length on fifth stump at 133 kph, Warner cuts this firmly to deep point for one.
good length ball swinging in toward off at 132 kph, opens the face to guide this to deep third for one.

good length ball swinging in on leg stump at 127 kph, Marsh defends down the wrong line and is hit above the knee roll. Big lbw shout denied as they scamper a leg bye with the ball trickling into cover. Aiden Markram signals fairly quickly for a review.  Height was a major issue, not to mention whether or not it pitched in line. Replays show Marsh was hit above the pads on the back leg but his leg was flexing quite low. Ball-tracking shows the ball indeed pitched in line and was going to hit middle stump below the bails. Three reds light up. Decision overturned.
good length ball on off, defended to cover.
fullish length swinging in toward off stump at 129 kph, Marsh drives this off the inner half of the bat and gets enough of it to clear midwicket with a mishit to the rope.
good length ball on the stumps, defended.
Sundar overcorrects short and wide on seventh stump, Warner leans back to slap this through cover for two.
into the second tier over square leg! Full straying on the pads again, Warner breaks out the slog sweep and carts this five rows back into the mezzanine landing 88 meters back.
full outside leg, Warner slog sweeps this and gets enough meat on this to place it wide of short fine leg to the rope.
good length ball on sixth stump, Marsh backs away to cut and backward point makes a diving stop to knock this down and keep it to just a single.
good length ball slanted across fourth stump, Marsh goes to punch off the back foot and is beaten.
good length ball slanted across off stump, defended to cover.
back of a length on off stump at 131 kph, punched to extra cover, diving stop keeps the string of dot balls going.
back of a length on fourth stump at 132 kph, goes back to flick to mid-on for none.
slower ball back of a length outside leg at 115 kph, goes back to defend to midwicket.
back of a length on middle at 128 kph, punched firmly but straight to mid-off for none.
good length ball on middle at 131 kph, defended to mid-off.
good length slower ball on off stump, blunted into the off side with soft enough hands to pinch a single.
back of a length on fifth stump, Marsh goes to pull this and drags a bottom edge through backward square leg, diving stop at the rope saves a run to keep this to three.
full in the slot wider on eighth stump, Marsh leans forward and smokes a drive wider between cover and extra cover to the rope.
fullish length angled across sixth stump at 134 kph, shoveled on the up high over cover and bounces away to the rope.
full on fourth stump at 139 kph, defended on the front foot to mid-off.
full outside leg at 139 kph, flicked fine wide of the keeper to the fine leg rope.
half-volley on the legs, whipped high over square leg and bounces away to the rope.
good length ball seaming away from fifth stump at 132 kph, left alone by Warner.
good length ball swinging in on middle at 133 kph, defended to mid-off.
good length ball on the legs, goes to flick and misses off the pads dribbling into square leg for a run.

good length ball in the sixth stump channel at 132 kph, Salt pokes at this flat-footed and gets a healthy edge through to the keeper. Bizarre sequence as nobody really appeals behind the wicket and Bhuvi only gives a belated shout before it's given out. But it was an obvious edge. The stadium is loud tonight.
back of a length on fifth stump at 126 kph, goes to cut and miscues this into the ground dribbling toward cover for a run.
good length on middle and off at 128 kph, defended to midwicket.
yorker on middle jammed out to mid-off for none. Mukesh is getting mobbed by his teammates as he helps Delhi seal an improbable seven-run win.

full on middle and leg, heaved wide of deep midwicket for just a single. Somehow they managed to jog just one instead of hustling for two to leave the Super Over as a possibility. Barring a wide or no ball, Delhi has sewn up their second win.
low full toss on the ankles at 141 kph, flicked out tamely to deep midwicket for one.
139 kph delivery lands full on fourth stump, drives this firmly to long-on for one.
wide yorker on sixth stump at 139 kph, Sundar tries to open the face to guide this to third man but misses.
full and wide on seventh stump at 138 kph, punches this wide of the cover sweeper for a jogged two.
full outside leg, Sundar just taps this gently into midwicket for one wanting to keep the strike for the start of the final over.

full on the legs at 145 kph, Sundar clears the front leg and shovels this high over wide long-on, bisecting Warner at long-on and another fielder running across from deep midwicket one bounce over the rope.
full outside leg stump at 144 kph, follows Jansen backing away from leg and it is jammed out through the leg side for one.

full and wide, Klaasen blisters a drive flat to the cover sweeper but picks him out too well. Sharp catch taken at knee height reaching forward five yards in from the rope after jogging 10 yards to his right.

dropped! Full at 143 kph on off stump, Klaasen miscues a skied drive swirling over extra cover. Marsh is running backward trying to take this over the shoulder but his body is in awful position trying to crane his head backwards for the catch and it slips through his hands. Warner had a much better angle coming over from mid-off but eased off trying to avoid a collision with Marsh who was going full steam for the chance.
yorker on the stumps, jammed out down the ground and they scamper a tight two beating the relay from Axar that short hops Nortje and nearly takes his head off.

tremendous tumbling scoop by Washington Sundar! Shuffles low across his stumps tumbling over in the process trying to scoop this full delivery from off stump but maintains his head stillness in spite of the tangled limbs elsewhere to focus on flicking the ball away past leg stump to the fine leg rope.
low full toss on the legs, flicked away for one.
length ball on sixth stump, slices this 117 kph slower delivery high over backward point and beats the sweeper Ripal Patel's diving effort.
full on sixth stump at 139 kph, driven to long-off for one.
full on the legs, flicked to the leg side for one.

a matador red cape diving effort at long-on by Warner turns two into four! Knee high full toss on the stumps, flicked to wide long-on. Should be two but Warner takes an awkward angle coming in off the rope trying to stop this ball and dives over it in the end.
full on the stumps, driven down the ground to wide long-on for one.
length ball on middle, Klaasen trusts the bounce on this 146 kph delivery and heaves this high and deep over the square leg rope.
short on the hips, goes to pull this and misses off the thigh guard, it balloons off the body to the left of Salt who takes an athletic one-handed catch for a theatrical dot ball.
back of a length on middle, but this time angled into the body from around the wicket, tapped away off the back foot for one.
144 kph on lands back of a length on middle, Sundar gets creative backing away a touch to ramp this over third man to the rope.
138 kph full on off, Klaasen heaves this just short of midwicket on the edge of the ring, short hops off his leg for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, goes to cut but is beaten.
good length ball on the legs, flicked through midwicket for one.
good length ball on middle, jammed out.
full on fifth stump, driven to the cover sweeper for one.
full on middle, flicked to wide long-on for two.
good length ball on middle, goes back to punch down the ground for one.
back of a length on middle, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
back of a length on middle and leg, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
back of a length on leg, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, goes back to punch to extra cover for none.
full on fifth stump, Sundar premeditates a reverse sweep first ball behind point to the sweeper for one.
drag on! Good length ball skids on from fifth stump toward off, Markram goes back to cut but is cramped for room and a bottom edge cannons on to leg stump.
marginally short on middle, Klaasen picks the length early and rocks back to smoke this past wide deep midwicket to the rope. First boundary in three overs for Sunrisers.
good length on leg stump, flicked into midwicket for one.
good length ball on middle, goes back to punch to long-on for one.

charges a length ball but gets nowhere close to the pitch and punches with hard hands in front of his body at knee height straight back to Kuldeep at head head by more in line with his left shoulder. He reaches up to calmly take this return chance. It was hit firmly but not blistered by any stretch.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched to long-on for one.
full on the legs, flicked to long-on for one.
back of a length on off, tapped into the covers for one.
good length ball on off, flicked to long-on for one.
full on fifth stump, miscues a drive back to Ishant.
length ball on fifth stump, Tripathi drives at this 139 kph delivery. The extra bit of zip is enough to find the outside edge that carries comfortably to Salt.
short and wide slower ball again at 120 kph, this time Tripathi slaps over the top of this and misses.
short and wide slower ball at 118 kph, slapped to the cover sweeper for two.
back of a length on the stumps, flicked through wide long-on for one.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked into midwicket for one.
Good length ball on off, flicked through midwicket for one.

flighted more on a good length on middle, Agarwal charges and is beaten badly in flight, reaches a long way in front of his body to get bat on his but winds up shoveling this straight up to Aman at long-on. Simple catch taken 10 yards in from the rope at waist height.
back of a length on fifth stump, Tripathi charges and is beaten in flight but punches on the up and sends this to the cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on middle, backs away and cuts this to the sweeper for one.
back of a length on off stump slower ball, Tripathi tries to poke this through the off side but his timing is off and misses.

dropped! 132 kph ball lands full on leg stump, flicked flat and low to Mukesh Kumar on the ring at backward square leg. He lunges forward and lets it clumsily slip through his fingers at ankle height. Tough chance, 7 of 10 on difficulty because of the speed it came to him at relatively short distance, but it was straight to him and Delhi needed something to go their way here and once again it's a good example of why they're sitting in last place.
back of a length on off, goes to chop this again through the off side but miscues this into the ground and it backspins just wide of leg stump.
124 kph delivery lands back of a length on fifth stump, goes back and across to flick into vacant midwicket for a sharp two.
first boundary for more than four overs!  131 kph length ball on sixth stump, carves this on the up through wide extra cover to beat the sweeper to the rope.
full on fifth stump, punched in the air to wide long-off for two.
short on middle, pulled to wide deep midwicket for one.
full on off, driven to long-off for one.
good length ball flicked through the leg side for one.
back of a length on middle, swatted back to the bowler.
full on middle, sweeps this behind square leg for one.
short on off, keeps a touch low and is pulled to wide long-on for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, flicked through midwicket for one.
135 kph bouncer on middle, Agarwal top edges a pull that swirls to deep fine leg, slapped back into play by the fielder running across at the rope to keep this to two.
full on middle, defended back to Marsh. Police siren goes off! Felon on the loose! Actually it's just Marsh being collared for overstepping on that ball. No ball and free hit to come.
122 kph delivery lands back of a length on fourth stump, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
length ball on sixth stump, charges a 127 kph delivery and slaps this into the ground back to Marsh.
back of a length on off, tapped with an open face behind point for one.
good length ball on off at 128 kph, tap and run in front of point for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, tapped behind point with an open face for one.

good length ball on middle, awkward flick across the line misses as he's struck on the knee. Big lbw shout denied. Looked pretty out live. But they opt against using a review. Only doubt was whether it pitched in line but live it looked like it was on leg stump. They take a leg bye as the ball caroms to point.
back of a length on fifth stump, slapped to the sweeper for one.
good length ball on middle, defended back to Kuldeep.
good length on fourth stump, goes back to pull through midwicket for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, goes back to defend and misses.
short on fifth stump, backs away to cut, diving effort by the point fielder slows the ball down short of the sweeper allowing them to run two.
good length ball on off, tapped away for one.

back of a length on fourth stump, tap and run behind point. Marsh charges in, collects and fires a one-bounce throw at the bowler's end. It hits Tripathi in the back of the leg as he collides with Axar while stumbling forward to make his ground.
full on fifth stump, punched through cover to the sweeper for one.
back of a length on off, punched into the off side for one.
full on off, defended to cover.
slower wide yorker arrives at shin height on the wide guideline, slapped to point for none.
147 kph delivery lands full on fourth stump, backs away to punch this past Nortje through mid-off to the rope.
bouncer on leg stump at 146 kph, Tripathi turtles his head while crouching before deciding to short arm tuck a shot that comes off a top edge into vacant short fine leg for one.
nearly a carbon copy wicket! Fullish length targeting leg stump at 151 kph, Tripathi shuffles across to scoop over fine leg and misses as the ball just misses leg stump. No wide called.
Good length ball on fourth stump, defended back to Nortje.

bullseye! Slower length ball at 120 kph, Brook shuffles away across his stumps trying to scoop this over fine leg, but deep fine leg is back on the rope so the shot would not have produced a boundary. Strange option taken by Brook to try to relieve the dot ball pressure building on him and he looks even more foolish as the lack of pace throws off his timing with the ball hitting the top of middle stump.
Axar darts in a quicker ball at 104 kph landing on a fullish length on sixth stump, in the slot to drive and smokes this through extra cover to the rope.
full on fourth stump, shuffles across to sweep but picks out square leg for none.
back of a length on middle, goes back to punch to Axar for none.
good length ball on fifth stump grips and straightens past a back foot punch.
full on off, punched back to Axar for none.
full on fourth stump, punched to long-off for one.
short on sixth stump at 114 kph, Mayank not fooled by the slower ball and spanks a cut in front of point to the rope.
back of a length on fifth stump at 137 kph, defended to the off side for none.
back of a length at 135 kph follows Brook backing away from leg and he fights this off into midwicket for one.
short on fifth stump, Brook backs away to cut a 136 kph delivery and misses.
143 kph ball lands short on fifth stump, slapped to the sweeper for one.
back of a length on off, tapped with an open face to deep third for one.
back of a length on middle stump, backs away to cut and bottom edges this to deep fine leg for one.
slower ball at 120 kph lands full on fifth stump, punched to mid-off for none.
full on fifth stump, pushed into the off side for one.
back of a length on fifth stump at 131 kph, comes down the pitch to flick but is hustled and comes off the body for none.
short and wide at 137 kph, slices a cut behind point and picks the gap to go tot he rope.
back of a length on the stumps, goes back to flick through square leg for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, plays well inside the line to leave.
back of a length on middle, defended to midwicket for none.
full and follows Mayank outside leg stump at 144 kph, just opens the front leg and punches this high over mid-on to the rope.
good length ball on the stumps, punched down the ground for one.

back of a length ball angled into the body, big sound and deflection as Brook tries to fight this off. Appeal for caught behind given not out. After a long chat, Warner is convinced by Salt more than anyone to go for a review.  The sound live appeared to be too thick for it to be bat and was more off the body. Sure enough, the ultraedge shows it came off the thigh. Not out stands. Nortje never really looked interested. Review lost.
back of a length on fifth stump at 146 kph, defended to point.
good length ball on fifth stump at 134 kph, punches this firmly between point and cover and it bounces away for two.
fullish length ball outside off, sizzling square drive goes through the off side to the rope.

dropped! Marsh dives right at first slip but can't hold onto a tough chance. Good length ball on sixth stump, Mayank pokes at this nervously and the edge flies low to Marsh's right at knee height. He dives full extension and gets his right hand to it but can't hold on. It would've gone straight to an orthodox second slip. Impressive that Marsh's dive even allowed his hand to get to the ball.
fullish length on sixth stump, goes to drive and a thick edge flies wide of backward point to deep third for one.
bold leave by Brook! Good length ball on sixth stump seams back sharply as Brook shoulders arms and it fizzes just past off stump.
full and wide on seventh stump, goes to drive and is beaten.
